data.one_liner: A simple Flutter package for managing overlay loading during async tasks.
data.what_it_does: It provides an easy way to show and hide an overlay loader over your UI using static methods when fetching remote data or running long asynchronous tasks. It supports customization of the overlay color, progress indicator, and safe area behavior.
use_when: You need a quick imperative way to display a global loading overlay during network requests.
You want to customize whether the loader overlays app bars or bottom app bars.
avoid_when: You are building your app around declarative state-driven loading screens or custom state management solutions.
You require complex animations or multi-step progress flows built directly into the widget tree.
strengths: Very easy to use with just two lines of code for showing and hiding.
Supports customizable overlay properties, theme data, and safe area behavior.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative static calls (Loader.show and Loader.hide) rather than declarative widget building.
Limited documentation beyond basic usage snippets.
data.setup_notes: No native configuration steps or build_runner required.
